name: TV/TVC Provider Operation Broker
purpose: Reuse the existing TV/TVC provider-operation broker as the bounded provider/session execution surface for a manifest-selected provider operation without creating another broker, credential route, transition authority, or provider-specific governance boundary.
trigger: a governed invocation requires an existing TV/TVC provider-operation profile through the canonical broker
reuse_instructions: Reuse TVC-PROVIDER-OPERATION-BROKER-003 and its registered provider profiles. TV/TVC remains credential/provider authority; Interlock/InTr remains transition authority. Do not create an alternate provider broker, vault, credential mechanism, or provider-specific governance plane.
